summary: Comprehensive frontend-only Playwright validation of the Vegith Pinnacle single-page marketing site. All 15 features from the review request passed end-to-end. No backend testing performed (per request - purely static site).
tests_executed: Homepage loads at / with hero headline 'Manpower & Integrated Facility Management, redefined.' and eyebrow 'SINCE 2018 · A VEGITH GROUP COMPANY' - PASS
All 8 sticky-header nav links present and smooth-scroll to their sections (about, why-us, pillars, compliance, process, industries, presence, contact) - PASS
'Get in Touch' header CTA (header-cta-contact) scrolls to contact section - PASS
About section renders 'A Vegith Group company built for the long haul.' with Commitment/Dedication/Delivery value cards - PASS
WhyUs renders all 6 benefit cards (Comprehensive Solutions, 24/7 Support, Client-Centric, Cost Efficiency, Compliance & Safety, Managed by Professionals) - PASS
Two large pillar cards (pillar-staffing, pillar-facility) present - PASS
All 11 staffing tabs (temporary, permanent, payroll, onboarding, leave, attendance, hrops, recruitment, deployment, compliance, pan-india) switch the detail card correctly with correct title - PASS
Facility group tabs: soft=7, technical=9, specialized=8 services (exact counts match) - PASS
Compliance section renders exactly 13 cards (PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, UAN, ECR, Statutory Management etc.) - PASS
Process Flow renders 14 steps; step 01 = 'Site Analysis', step 14 = 'Measuring Effectiveness' - PASS
Industries section renders all 12 industry cards - PASS
Presence section renders 3 offices (Mumbai/Solitaire, Kolkata/Godrej Water Side, Bhiwandi/Yewai) with correct addresses - PASS
Contact form empty submit shows sonner error toast 'Please fill in your name, email and message.' - PASS
Contact form valid submit shows success toast 'Thank you — our team will reach out within 24 hours.' and resets form fields (static, no backend call) - PASS
Footer wordmark VEGITH PINNACLE + phone (+91 91364 07944), email (Hr@vegithglobal.com), website (www.vegithhr.com) render correctly - PASS
Mobile viewport (390x844): hamburger opens menu, mobile nav links work (about scrolls into view), mobile Get in Touch CTA visible - PASS
No console errors on initial page load (empty error array) - PASS
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Contact form uses browser-default <select> for 'I am interested in' instead of the project's shadcn Select component - not a bug, but inconsistent with the premium luxury design system used elsewhere.

Minor: sonner Toaster is mounted inside <Home /> component (App.js). If any future route is added the toaster won't show elsewhere; consider hoisting it above <Routes>. Cosmetic only for the current SPA.
test_credentials: N/A - no authentication in this app
seed_data_creation: None - static site, no data layer
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React SPA at https://staffing-fm-portal.preview.emergentagent.com. All content data in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js. Contact form is MOCKED (setTimeout + sonner toast, no backend). All data-testids are kebab-case: nav-link-{label}, staffing-tab-{key}, staffing-detail-{key}, facility-group-{key}, facility-group-content-{key}, facility-service-{group}-{i}, compliance-card-{idx 0-12}, process-step-{n 1-14}, contact-input-{name|email|company|interest|message}, contact-submit, footer-{copyright|phone|email|website}, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-nav-link-{label}, mobile-cta-contact. All flows verified in iteration_1.
